findings.description: The draft omitted `app_backtrack.rs` and the initial/thread-switch replay buffer helpers even though they still reinsert committed history into terminal scrollback after rollback, overlay close, and startup/thread-switch replay.
findings.resolution: Added the replay-helper paths to the implementation strategy, file list, risk register, and US-002 acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestedFix: Call out the remaining scrollback replay helpers explicitly so direction A covers them from the start.

findings.description: The draft let the retained inline transcript land independently of scrollback-emission removal, which would create a duplicate-history state.
findings.resolution: Recorded the atomic-ship requirement in the implementation strategy, risk section, acceptance criteria, and decomposition notes.
findings.suggestedFix: State that the retained viewport and scrollback-removal steps ship together.

findings.description: The first draft left the main retained transcript scroll model unresolved and did not specify whether the inline transcript was independently scrollable or tail-focused.
findings.resolution: Settled the design: the inline retained transcript stays tail-focused and the existing `Ctrl+T` transcript overlay remains the explicit full-history scroll surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the scroll model before implementation so US-001 is directly implementable.
